newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Broadway announces NZ$10.8-11.5 mln Chemstock sale.
newsitem.headline: Broadway announces NZ$10.8-11.5 mln Chemstock sale.

text.p: Broadway Industries Ltd on Thursday announced the conditional sale of Chemstock Animal Health to IAMA Trading (NZ) Proprietary, a wholly owned subsidiary of IAMA of Australia.
The sale price will be in a range of NZ$10.75 million to $11.5 million.
Broadway issued a "don't sell" notice to shareholders last week.
Broadway said the sale was subject to shareholder approval at the annual meeting on December 2, and Overseas Investment Commission approval.
If the transaction proceeds, the abnormal gain for Broadway will be in a range of $8.5 million to $9.25 million.
The transaction is effective from October 1 and settlement is likely to be December 9.
Broadway's directors said they considered it a very satisfactory consideration for the sale of Chemstock.
They said bids received for Southern Packaging had been inadequate, and the directors had decided to retain Southpak and concentrate on enhancing its profitability.
H.E. Perry has also been the subject of an extensive competitive sale process, the final outcome of which is still to be determined.
The directors said they would be considering in the New Year a capital repayment to shareholders.
